name: Roche lobe overflow, two magnetized stars
blurb: The two-star Roche lobe overflow preset (a 1 solar mass donor of 1 solar radius at 0.97 of its Roche lobe, and a 0.6 solar mass accretor of 0.6 solar radii, both gamma = 5/3, n = 3/2), with each star threaded by its own tangled Kolmogorov field confined to the star (plasma beta 1000 at the center), from different seeds.
